intended_object: The Chevalley–Serre generator E_i of the Lie algebra presented by Serre's relations for an integer matrix CM, i.e. the image of the free generator E_i in Mathlib's `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R CM`. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition applies the quotient map `serreMk = LieIdeal.mkQ (Relations.toIdeal R CM)` to `FreeLieAlgebra.of R (Generators.E i)`. That map goes from the free Lie algebra on the generators H_i, E_i, F_i to `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R CM`, so this is exactly the class of the free generator E_i in the presented algebra, as the docstring says.

The setting is already the natural one. It works over any commutative ring R, for any index type B with decidable equality (Mathlib's relations need this), and for any integer matrix, not only Cartan matrices. This is the same generality as Mathlib's `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra`.

Mathlib defines the presented algebra but gives no name to the images of its generators. Its file `SerreConstruction.lean` only defines the relators `HH`, `EF`, `HE`, `HF`, `adE` and `adF`, plus `toSet`, `toIdeal` and `ToLieAlgebra`. So there is no existing Mathlib counterpart, and the definition is a faithful naming of this standard generator.
